name: 7-fluorotryptamine
summary: 7-Fluorotryptamine (7-FT) is a serotonin receptor modulator and weak GPRC5A agonist of the tryptamine family. It is the 7-fluoro derivative of tryptamine. The drug is a low-potency agonist of the orphan receptor GPRC5A, with an EC50Tooltip half-maximal effective concentration of 7,200 nM. In addition to its GPRC5A agonism, 7-fluorotryptamine interacts with other receptors, such as the serotonin 5-HT4 receptor.

pharmacology.text: 7-Fluorotryptamine (7-FT) is a serotonin receptor modulator and weak GPRC5A agonist of the tryptamine family. The drug is a low-potency agonist of the orphan receptor GPRC5A, with an EC50 of 7,200 nM. Its GPRC5A agonism was first described in 2023.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of serotonin receptors and of the orphan receptor GPRC5A.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於血清素受體與孤兒受體GPRC5A的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于血清素受体与孤儿受体GPRC5A的实验室研究。

fact.en: It weakly switches on GPRC5A, a so-called orphan receptor, meaning one whose natural partner is still unknown. Such receptors are a standing puzzle in pharmacology.
fact.zh: 它會輕微活化GPRC5A，這是一個所謂的孤兒受體，也就是至今仍不知道其天然配對分子的受體。這類受體一直是藥理學上的謎題。
fact.zhHans: 它会轻微活化GPRC5A，这是一个所谓的孤儿受体，也就是至今仍不知道其天然配对分子的受体。这类受体一直是药理学上的谜题。
